inputs.sbc_source: J-GAAP filer; no share-based payment line in the FY2026 yuho cash-flow statement or notes and no dilutive shares (yuho p.1 note: diluted EPS not presented because there are no dilutive shares). SBC-zero market: house and street bases coincide.
inputs.share_count_basis: 67,510,308 issued less 9,338,037 treasury = 58,172,271 at 30 Sep 2026 (H1 FY2027 Tanshin, share-count note). No dilutive securities. Held FLAT: SBC is nil, buybacks (JPY5.0bn FY2026, JPY5.0bn again in H1 FY2027) are treated as value-neutral capital return. Share basis is post the 2-for-1 split of Oct 2024; pre-split EPS halved before computing historical EPS CAGRs.
inputs.fy_labelling_note: CSV/DB label FY2026 = year ended 31 March 2026 (Okuma's own label is 'FY2025'). Forecast year 1 = FY2027 = year ending 31 March 2027, the year guidance covers. MMP 2028 (Okuma label) = year ending 31 March 2029 = forecast year 3; 2030 Vision = year ending 31 March 2031 = year 5.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-11-06T06:30:00Z (TSE regular close, Fri 6 Nov 2026 15:30 JST; 52-week range 3,325-5,710)
inputs.cash_note: Cash and cash equivalents JPY63,591m per the H1 FY2027 cash-flow statement. Balance-sheet 'cash and deposits' is JPY69,040m; the JPY5,449m difference is time deposits over three months and is added in the equity bridge so it is counted once.
inputs.debt_note: JPY5,000m current portion of bonds + JPY25,000m long-term borrowings (JPY5,000m drawn in H1 FY2027 at ~1.3%). Lease liabilities (~JPY1.9bn, finance leases of 'minor importance' per the yuho) are excluded from debt under lease treatment (B).
inputs.wacc_rationale: JPY-denominated build. 10y JGB ~1.7% (Nov 2026) + equity risk premium ~5.75% x beta ~1.2 (cyclical capital goods) = cost of equity ~8.6%. Debt is ~12% of EV at ~1.3% pre-tax, which would pull a formal WACC to ~7.7%; the company is net cash so equity holders bear essentially all the risk and the house JPY-industrial reference (~9%) applies. 8.5% used in ALL scenarios: cyclicality is charged in the flows (explicit downturn years and mid-cycle terminal margins), not stacked onto the discount rate, and no per-scenario WACC differences.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost. Repayments of lease liabilities were JPY971m FY2026 and JPY501m H1 FY2027, interest on leases is negligible (total interest paid JPY167m H1 incl. borrowings); charged as lease_cost_pct_path 0.45% of revenue inside EBIT. Lease liabilities are therefore EXCLUDED from net debt. J-GAAP operating leases are already expensed inside operating profit, so no further adjustment. The remaining double-count (finance-lease depreciation inside D&A shielding tax) is ~0.4% x 30% of revenue and immaterial.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI stock of JPY12,416m (30 Sep 2026; up from JPY10,910m on a JPY1,133m subscription by minority shareholders in H1) deducted once, in the equity bridge at book. Flows are consolidated. NCI's share of profit is close to nil (FY2026 JPY73m; H1 FY2027 a JPY26m loss), so consolidated NOPAT ties to attributable net income within non-operating noise and no leakage driver is needed.
inputs.excluded_income_note: Flows are built from operating profit (EBITDA margin x revenue), so interest income (JPY578m FY2026) and dividend income (JPY1,181m FY2026 annualised from H1 JPY707m) are both outside the flows. Their source assets are in the bridge: cash in net_debt, time deposits and the cross-shareholding portfolio in equity_bridge. Investment securities (JPY50,915m carrying, AFS at fair value) are taken net of 30.1% tax on the JPY36,385m pre-tax unrealised gain (= JPY25,433m valuation difference net of tax / 0.699), i.e. JPY39,963m, because the company is an active seller (JPY4,592m proceeds, JPY3,703m gain in H1 FY2027).
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon, scenario-weighted (routing table row: operating company, non-US and cyclical; owner-fcf.md + owner-fcf-adaptations.md both applied). Okuma is a full-line CNC machine-tool maker with its own OSP control, 73% overseas sales, a net-cash balance sheet and no SBC; its value is a stream of highly cyclical owner FCF, so the owner-FCF engine is right and the adaptations (JPY WACC, one lease treatment, NCI once, matching-asset rule for the cross-shareholdings, SBC-zero band collapse, risk charged once) all bite. CYCLE FRAMING: FY2027 guidance (JPY260bn sales, JPY26bn operating profit = 10.0% margin, reaffirmed unchanged in the H1 Tanshin of 5 Nov 2026) sits above the 12-year average operating margin of 9.35% (range 3.9%-13.0%) and EBITDA margin of 13.0% (range 9.2%-15.7%); orders +44.4% YoY in H1 and a JPY144.7bn backlog are late-cycle signatures. Each scenario therefore runs an explicit downturn inside the 10-year path and the terminal-year margin is a MID-CYCLE margin (base 13.5% EBITDA / ~9% operating), not the current peak. The base deliberately sits below the MMP 2028 target of 11% operating margin because the prior plan (MMP 2025: 13-15%) delivered 6.6%. Reported FCF for FY2026 was negative (-JPY5,664m) only because PP&E capex spiked to JPY23.9bn for Dream Site Engineered Solutions and the Global Innovation Center; capex normalises to ~4.8% of revenue from year 3, slightly above D&A at 4.5%. Working capital: receivables + inventories (JPY129bn) far exceed payables (JPY23bn), so growth consumes cash -- wc_capture is NEGATIVE (-30% of the revenue change) and the downturn years release it. Buybacks are real (JPY5.0bn FY2026 and again in H1 FY2027) so the flat count is funded, not a convention. Terminal cap 13x FCF (cyclical range 12-15x) binds in every scenario against a Gordon of 15.7x at 8.5%/2.0%; this is the brake on paying a compounder multiple for a cyclical. Guidance net income JPY20.0bn includes the JPY3.7bn H1 gain on sale of securities and is not a run-rate.

equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2027 BS 30 Sep 2026: carrying JPY50,915m less deferred tax JPY10,952m on JPY36,385m pre-tax unrealised gain. Matching asset for the dividend income excluded from the flows.
Cash and deposits JPY69,040m less cash and cash equivalents JPY63,591m, H1 FY2027 BS/CF.
H1 FY2027 BS 30 Sep 2026. Charged once here; flows are consolidated.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: 10-year revenue CAGR FY2016-FY2026 of 2.5% (JPY183.5bn to JPY235.9bn, part of it yen depreciation) plus ~0.5pp for the automation/5-axis mix shift. Equity CAGR (6.4% 3yr, 7.4% 5yr) rejected as the primary: it reflects retained earnings piling up on a net-cash balance sheet and JPY25bn of unrealised gains on cross-shareholdings, not operating growth.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR 6.4% vs revenue 1.2% and EPS -12.3%: divergence far exceeds 30%. The 5-year figures (revenue 13.8%, EPS 44.5%) are measured off the COVID trough (FY2021 = year ended March 2021, operating margin 3.9%) and overstate trend; the 10-year revenue CAGR of 2.5% is the honest trend.
historical_growth.notes: All EPS CAGRs computed on the current post-split (Oct 2024, 2-for-1) share basis: FY2023 EPS JPY615.95 and FY2021 JPY66.15 halved to JPY307.98 and JPY33.08 before compounding against FY2026 JPY208.03. Owner-FCF series = reported FCF less interest income (SBC nil): FY2021 JPY14,577m, FY2023 JPY6,494m, FY2026 -JPY6,242m; CAGRs are undefined because the end year is negative on the Dream Site/GIC capex spike (JPY29.5bn total capex vs a JPY6-13bn norm). Owner FCF is structurally below net income here: NWC is ~45% of revenue and capex has exceeded D&A in 8 of the last 10 years.

base.growth_rationale: Y1 +10.5% = FY2027 guidance JPY260bn (H1 JPY118.1bn delivered; backlog JPY144.7bn covers H2). Y2 +6% on record H1 orders flowing through with the usual 2-3 quarter lag; Y3 +2% cycle plateau (~JPY282bn, above the MMP 2028 JPY270bn target). Y4-Y5 -8%/-3%: a machine-tool downturn of ordinary depth (the FY2019-FY2021 cycle fell 42%; the FY2024-FY2025 dip 9%). Y6-Y10 recover to a 2-3.5% nominal trend. 10-year CAGR 2.5%, equal to the FY2016-FY2026 actual.
base.margin_rationale: EBITDA pre-lease. Y1 14.4% = guided 10.0% operating margin + 4.3% D&A (H1 actual 14.6% included partial US tariff refunds). Y2 14.8% on volume leverage, Y3 14.5%, downturn 11.0%/11.5% (operating margin ~6.5%, FY2025-26 actual territory), recovery to a 13.5% mid-cycle = 9.0% operating margin, the 12-year average (9.35%) and ~2pp below the MMP 2028 target the prior plan missed by 7pp.
base.capex_da_rationale: D&A 3.9% FY2026 rising to 4.5% as Dream Site ES, GIC and the Global Repair Center depreciate. Capex 12.5% FY2026 was the build-out peak; H1 FY2027 ran 5.6%; 5.5% -> 5.0% -> 4.8% thereafter, slightly above D&A for a growing asset base. 12-year average capex intensity 5.1%.
base.tax_rationale: 30.1% Japanese statutory; FY2026 actual effective 26.0% with a 2.6pp R&D credit, FY2025 35.1%. Cash taxes paid were JPY2.5bn in FY2026 and JPY9.1bn in FY2024, i.e. they track the accrual with a one-year lag. 30% flat is the through-cycle cash rate; no carryforwards or allowance releases to ramp from.
base.wc_rationale: NWC (receivables JPY44bn + inventories JPY85bn - payables JPY23bn, net of JPY7.6bn advances) is ~45% of revenue; FY2024 OCF of JPY5.3bn on JPY19.4bn net income shows the drain in an upswing. -30% capture on the revenue change: growth consumes cash, the downturn releases it.
base.narrative: Cycle runs two more years then turns; margins never reach the MMP target; terminal is mid-cycle.

bull.growth_rationale: Guidance beaten (JPY264bn) as backlog converts faster; Y2-Y3 carry the +44% order surge to ~JPY302bn by FY2029, i.e. the 2030 Vision's JPY300bn two years early; a shallow downturn (-4%/0%) because aerospace/defence/data-centre/semicap demand is less cyclical than the auto-led cycles of the past; 4.2% 10-year CAGR.
bull.margin_rationale: 15.5% EBITDA at the top (operating margin ~11%, the MMP 2028 target met on time); downturn 13.0%; mid-cycle 15.0% = ~10.5% operating margin, above the 12-year average on 5-axis/multitasking mix, OSP-based automation solutions and the in-house manufacturing push. Still short of the 2030 Vision's 15% operating margin.
bull.narrative: Structural automation demand lifts the mid-cycle; MMP 2028 margin target delivered.

bear.growth_rationale: FY2027 lands at JPY255bn (H2 slips on tariff and yen noise); the order surge proves to be the peak and the cycle turns in Y2 with the yen back toward 140/USD and a China EV capex pause; Y3-Y4 -12%/-8% is a downturn of FY2019-21 depth (-42% peak to trough over three years was the actual); recovery to a 2% trend. Revenue in Y10 only JPY246bn, a 0.4% 10-year CAGR -- i.e. the yen tailwind of the last decade does not repeat.
bear.margin_rationale: EBITDA 13.5% in Y1 (guidance missed by ~1pp), falling to 8.0% at the trough (operating margin ~3.5%, the FY2021 actual); mid-cycle 12.0% = ~7.5% operating margin, the FY2025-FY2026 run-rate, as Chinese/Taiwanese price pressure in standard machines and persistent input-cost and freight inflation cap recovery.
bear.narrative: Peak-of-cycle now; yen reverses; the MMP 2028 target is missed like MMP 2025 was.

scenario_narratives.base: Okuma delivers FY2027 guidance (JPY260bn, 10% operating margin) off a JPY145bn backlog, and the record H1 order intake (+44%) carries revenue to a ~JPY282bn plateau by FY2029 -- above the MMP 2028 sales target. But orders up 44-62% year on year are what the top of a machine-tool cycle looks like, so years 4-5 carry an ordinary downturn (-11% cumulative, margins back to the FY2025-26 6.5% operating level) before a recovery to a 2-3.5% nominal trend. The mid-cycle operating margin settles at 9%, the 12-year average: better than FY2025-26 thanks to the 5-axis/multitasking mix and the new Dream Site automation capacity, but below the 11% MMP 2028 target, because the prior plan's 13-15% target produced 6.6%. Working capital (~45% of revenue) absorbs cash in the upswing and releases it in the downturn; capex normalises to ~4.8% after the FY2026 build-out peak. The cross-shareholdings (JPY40bn after tax) and net cash (JPY34bn) are real and counted once, outside the flows.
scenario_narratives.bull: The current upcycle is structural rather than merely cyclical: US reshoring, aerospace/defence, data-centre and semicap demand -- customers less tied to the auto cycle -- plus labour-shortage-driven automation keep orders elevated, so revenue reaches the 2030 Vision's JPY300bn by FY2029 and the downturn is shallow (-4% then flat). The OSP control, Thermo-Friendly technology and the new Global Innovation Center/DSES capacity lift the mid-cycle operating margin to ~10.5% (MMP 2028's 11% delivered at the top), with in-house manufacturing and price pass-through offsetting input costs. The yen stays near guidance assumptions (159/USD). Even here the 2030 Vision's 15% operating margin is not reached.
scenario_narratives.bear: This is the peak. The +44-62% order growth reverses as it did in FY2019-21: China's large EV-maker projects do not recur, US SME capex stalls under tariff and rate uncertainty, Europe stays flat, and the yen appreciates toward 140/USD, cutting translated revenue and margin. Revenue falls 20% over FY2028-FY2030 and the operating margin troughs near the FY2021 3.5%, with high fixed costs at the newly expanded Konan plant amplifying the drop. Recovery is capped at a 7.5% mid-cycle operating margin -- the FY2025-26 run-rate -- as Chinese and Taiwanese makers compress pricing in standard machines and freight, steel and wage inflation outrun pass-through. The balance sheet (net cash, 70% equity ratio) means this is a value outcome, not a solvency one.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: House default is 15/50/35. Bear raised to 25%: orders +44-62% YoY and record backlog are the classic late-cycle signature for a machine-tool maker whose revenue fell 42% in the last downturn, and FY2027 guidance already embeds a weaker yen (159/USD vs 150.8 actual) -- no solvency risk, but a real probability that today's numbers are the peak. Bull cut to 25%: it needs three independent things -- the cycle to extend, the MMP 2028 margin target to be met after MMP 2025 missed by 7pp, and the yen to stay weak. Base 50%: guidance delivered, then an ordinary cycle.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value a cyclical on its mid-cycle owner FCF, not on the current upcycle. The three paths each contain an explicit downturn and capitalise a terminal-year margin that is a through-cycle average (base 9% operating), with a 13x FCF cap on the terminal value so a compounder multiple is never paid for a capital-goods maker. Risk is charged once, in the flows and the weights; the discount rate is the same JPY 8.5% in every scenario. Cash, time deposits and the cross-shareholdings are added once in the bridge because their income is excluded from the flows; NCI is deducted once at book. SBC is nil so the house/street band collapses to a point.
key_risks_to_valuation: Cycle timing: the model assumes two more up-years before the downturn; if orders roll over in FY2028 the base collapses toward the bear path (the bear is weighted 25% for this reason).
Yen: 73% of sales are overseas and guidance assumes 159/USD; a 10-yen appreciation is worth roughly JPY10-15bn of revenue and a few billion of operating profit at current translation sensitivity.
Margin execution: the mid-cycle 9% operating margin is a judgment between the 12-year average (9.35%) and the FY2025-26 actual (6.6-7.1%); the MMP 2028 target (11%) is in the bull only.

Working-capital capture (-30%) is the least observable driver: NWC/revenue has ranged 40-50% and a disciplined inventory programme would add value; a sloppy upswing (FY2024 OCF JPY5.3bn on JPY19.4bn net income) would subtract it.
Cross-shareholding value (JPY40bn after tax, ~JPY690/share) depends on Japanese equity prices and on the company continuing to monetise them; a 20% market fall removes ~JPY140/share.
Terminal cap at 13x FCF binds in every scenario; at 15x the base rises ~5-6%, at 11x it falls by a similar amount.
